stage: A2, one bounded presence and price-width audit; no B1

presence.family_scope: all compatible laminar families and all continuous nonnegative parameters; reuse saved minimum-loss fits
presence.compression: keep inclusion-maximal compatible supports; every removed support has a kept superset, with zero extension
presence.omission_definition: shared block absent iff both r_C and x_C absent/zero
presence.candidate_rule: all non-singleton blocks; no truth labels and no hard-locking greedy blocks
presence.observable_effect: P-only future DR: report maximum r_C separately from x_C and sum. This is a possibility filter, not a price score.
presence.unbounded: verify a feasible base point and a nonnegative recession direction; never cap coefficients

width.targets: all candidates with a compatible omission and positive feasible r_C; no true block labels
width.definition: max absolute r_C-r'_C over two complete history-compatible models with equal future predictions; absent C has r_C=0
width.aggregation: per response take maximum remaining target width; menu minimizes its predicted expectation; no width normalization or parameter prior
width.response: predicted independent whole-session Bernoulli at existing q values; each session energy 1, peak 1, background .2, reward .1, paid-menu expectation .27
width.decision: no new data if there is no positive P-effect unresolved target; otherwise retain all tied best menus and use fixed menu order for a single recommendation
width.comparison: existing D-opt feature determinant, uniformly random paid menu and no reward; same initial state and stopping rule
width.boundaries: R-channel width only, not confidence or shared-block absence; X remains free and shares supports
width.acceptance: must distinguish existing 0.82 versus 0.18 full-recovery menus and report all-tie sensitivity/cost; if not, reject price score. Passing this diagnostic alone does not pass B1
width.no_claim: R-channel width and actual synthetic full_recovery are not shared R/X topology identification. Unobserved X-only blocks remain allowed.

evaluation.actual_outcomes: reuse prior A2b weight=1 independent actual-pattern outcomes after design lock; no rerun of completed records
evaluation.additional_weak_truths: weak_line only: three equal-history models with common block .4, one pair block .03 on 01/02/12, and singleton weights preserving observed row sums. Pair01 reuses its 8 existing A2b records; only pair02/12 add 16 evaluations.
evaluation.forecast_mismatch: not expanded here; retained existing failure
evaluation.report: full effective-block recovery, target weak-block recovery, no-new-data, costs, all successes/failures/timeouts/unresolved

reproducibility: deterministic enumeration; no new RNG draws. Protocol, source/input hashes, environment and per-case checkpoints preserved. Solver failure cannot become zero width. No silent rerun. No line-weight floors/ceilings.
stop_gate: No engineering expansion. If width just repeats D-opt or pays more without gain, retain diagnostic only or reject it.
reporting_revision: Rename the 24 total same-history model patterns; new actual evaluations remain 16. No experimental setting or score changed.
